purpose: functional verification of reading files from machine disk snapshots; no timing claim

cases.name: a template machine's snapshot is listed and read, odd names included
a cloud image never booted: its root is found and read, links are not followed, /boot by number
what cannot be read is refused, each with why

detail.a directory read as a file: "/srv" is a directory, not a file
detail.a file listed as a directory: "/srv/data/note" is a file, not a directory
detail.a path that climbs: "/srv/../etc": a path has no `.` or `..` in it
detail.a partition that is not ext: partition 14 holds no ext2, ext3 or ext4 filesystem, which is all this reads
